summary: Zipporah 'Zippy' Fish is one of the most rapidly rising stars in Australian Rules Football, playing as a midfielder and half-back for the Sydney Swans in the elite AFLW competition. Following a dominant 2025 debut season in which she won the Telstra AFLW Rising Star award and was voted the AFLPA Best First-Year Player, her athletic trajectory has accelerated in 2026 with selection for the national team against Ireland and league-leading endurance metrics. Beyond her on-field excellence, Fish possesses an exceptionally distinct and commercially attractive personal brand anchored by her highly memorable name, First Nations heritage (proud Noongar, Wongi, and Larrakia woman), and a grounded, family-centric backstory featuring a 14-day transcontinental road trip from the remote mining town of Newman to Sydney with her father. Her cultural relevance is surging, evidenced by crossover appearances in Vogue Australia and prime-time sports entertainment television (The Front Bar). However, her overall commercial evaluation is constrained by a complete absence of public or authoritative social media data (due to platforms being unavailable for direct evaluation) and a lack of disclosed individual endorsement figures. Consequently, her public brand appeal remains highly potent in Australia, but her exact quantitative audience reach and direct commercial performance metrics are currently unverifiable.
